headline: Biden Memoir Discloses Decision Blocking Trump Transition Team Pre-Inauguration Moscow Talks
summary: Former US President Joe Biden revealed in his upcoming memoir that he rejected requests from Donald Trump's transition team to authorize direct negotiations with Russian President Vladimir Putin prior to the 2025 inauguration.
why: US foreign policy transition protocols govern official diplomatic contact with foreign powers prior to presidential inaugurations.
